A '''Character''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] card type. Character *subtypes* (also called affiliations) in Premiere are [[Rebel]], [[Imperial]], [[Alien]], and [[Droid]]. [[Droid]]s are characters with ability 0.

Do not confuse this with [[Character Weapon]] (the weapon subtype printed Weapon — Character).

Characters have power, ability, deploy, forfeit, and landspeed. Many also have [[Pilot]] or [[Warrior]] icons (skills, not subtypes).
